tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Real, sourced events on Quo's calendar (Art Basel, F1 Miami GP, Ultra, etc.), dates, venue, and demand level. Useful for planning a trip around, or timing a ride request against, a specific event.

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: Practical guidance for a Florida city Quo serves: getting around, the airport transfer, neighborhoods, and dining/nightlife/culture picks. Same content as the site's public guide pages.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Search Quo's library of real, specific Florida travel answers, airport transfers, getting around, event logistics, itineraries by city. Returns matching question/answer pairs.

tools.name: ask_concierge
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question and get a grounded answer from Quo's own concierge, the same AI that answers the site's chat widget. Strictly grounded in real Quo information; never invents a price or a policy.

tools.name: request_verification_code
tools.description: Send a 6-digit SMS code to a phone number, to verify the caller owns it before showing ride history or allowing a cancellation. Required before calling list_my_rides, get_ride_status, cancel_ride, or redeem_gift.

tools.name: verify_code
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit code sent by request_verification_code. On success, returns a session_token, pass this exact string as session_token to list_my_rides, get_ride_status, cancel_ride, and redeem_gift. The token expires after 24 hours.

tools.name: list_my_rides
tools.description: List the verified phone number's ride history and any upcoming reservation. Requires session_token from verify_code.

tools.name: get_ride_status
tools.description: Get the live status of one of the verified phone's rides by its booking code. Requires session_token from verify_code. tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Cancel one of the verified phone's upcoming rides. Refuses if the ride is already en route (call the concierge instead), already completed, or already canceled. Requires session_token from verify_code.

tools.name: redeem_gift
tools.description: Redeem a Quo gift card code onto the verified phone number as ride credit. Requires session_token from verify_code.

tools.name: get_payment_method
tools.description: Check whether the verified phone has a card linked for agentic checkout, and if so its brand/last4 and current spending cap in dollars. If nothing is linked, points to /link-card. Requires session_token from verify_code.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_verification_code" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a 6-digit SMS code to a phone number, to verify the caller owns it before showing ride history or allowing a cancellation. Required before calling list_my_…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_ride_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "reserve_and_pay" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Reserve a Quo ride and complete payment immediately, using the guest's already-linked card, only works if get_payment_method shows a linked card whose remaining…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_concierge, link_payment_method · Private data: verify_code · Public sink: reserve_ride, request_verification_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_concierge, link_payment_method · Private data: verify_code · Public sink: reserve_ride, request_verification_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
